metadata.evidence_scope: Frozen connectome-model prediction of DNg02 firing; no biological or flight validation
limitations: Graph-selected upstream inputs are hypotheses; seven lack a verified cell-type label and none are assumed to be visual sensory inputs.
DNg02 has published flight-amplitude evidence, but this frozen assay predicts neural firing only, not takeoff or flight.
FAFB brain omits complete ventral nerve cord and wing-muscle system.
Shiu LIF model was biologically validated for feeding/grooming; these DNg02 outputs have no new independent biological validation.
Only200ms and3 simulation seeds; no general biological efficacy conclusion.
DNg02 subtypes a..g are pooled; signed-connectivity weights reflect author predictions.
Zero spontaneous activity means sham0 is expected and tests only this driven state.
Existing author model has a reset compatibility correction (remove undeclared w assignment).
Open-loop brain signal; no sensor feedback.
compatibility_adjustments: Removed undeclared upstream reset assignment w=0; source untouched
data_loading_adjustments: Projected three required connectivity columns; retained every edge and cell
metadata.hypothesis: The eight upstream targets, selected by positive graph weight before observing activity, increase pooled DNg02 firing relative to sham; removing all outgoing target weights reduces the DNg02 mean rate by at least 80%. This is a model-generated hypothesis, not an established biological finding.
metadata.question: Do eight connectivity-selected right-side upstream neurons drive firing in flight-related DNg02 cells in the fixed full-v783 LIF model, and does this response require their outgoing connections?

question: Does stimulating the sealed graph-selected upstream inputs produce a measurable DNg02 readout difference in the FAFB FlyWire v783 Shiu/Brian2 model?

hypothesis: With adult Drosophila melanogaster FAFB FlyWire v783 IDs and pinned Shiu/Brian2 commit `91bdd1e7dcf193f3e7ca5a8933497fcef63b7960`, 150 Hz stimulation of the 8 preregistered upstream inputs for 200 ms will increase mean DNg02 spikes/s across the sealed 25 DNg02 readout cells versus sham, with positive paired seed-wise differences for seeds `42/43/44`.

candidate_tests:
- "A: upstream stimulation vs sham; conditions sham vs upstream_drive; 8 graph-selected inputs at 150 Hz, 200 ms, seeds 42/43/44; measure mean DNg02 spikes/s across all 25 cells and paired seed-wise difference; success if positive paired difference every seed."
- "B: outgoing-connectivity necessity control; conditions upstream_drive vs outgoing_disconnected; identical input with stimulated inputs' outgoing connections disconnected; measure 1 - disconnected/driven mean rate per seed; success if >=0.80 reduction for every nonzero driven seed."

selected_test: A

rationale: Select A first because it is the propagation and feasibility test: before testing causal necessity by disconnecting outgoing edges, the sealed upstream drive must first show that activity can propagate to the DNg02 readout under the fixed model, dt, duration, seeds, targets, and measurement rules. B is more informative causally, but only after A produces a DNg02 readout difference.

ids_hashes: design `dng02-input-v1`, sha256 `e37611813b2b081880e9e5eb545e26a503abff618cef0c807bac15db61238ec6`, initial_selected_test `A`; sources/claims: Namiki `src_ed165fa0105fe71168bc` / `clm_3b70e19bd21e4140bb41fc8ca5b2d9b7`; v783 annotation `src_8ed6cdb697519ced31f7` / `clm_56ffe1e8dc514ef6a84029d464124c34`; Shiu `src_26b56b10e90a9cdc96ac` / `clm_f0e3ce6e163f42a8abc9f1b407af3be9`; hypothesis `clm_6640c27508c34365a3df7e1d028248fc`; code `src_38fb76e91124b3802a6d`, hash `fc45837d7122c6ce2a7f3f2f23c515992e4b232aadb919efabb72337fac88e4e`.

branches: If A succeeds for all seeds, run B next without changing parameters. If A is null or not positive for every seed, preserve the null and do not retune. If A produces no DNg02 spikes, run direct-DNg02 calibration only to diagnose readout excitability. If responses are unspecific or seed-unstable, report that instability and preregister any follow-up separately.

limitations: Evidence supports DNg02 identity and tethered-flight wingbeat-amplitude relevance only; it does not establish flight initiation, stable body flight, natural sensory drive, or calibrated actuator mapping. Shiu validation is feeding/grooming scoped and not DNg02-biological validation. Neural rates must not be interpreted as body or flight behavior.
